name: Fairy: ~Shopping Day~
source:
Yesterday you met a fairy named Illea and become friends. Today you will spend your first day together in the city you moved to. 

[From [url=http://lunaen.com/games/fairy/]official site[/url]]
translation:
昨天，你遇見了名叫伊莉婭的妖精，並和她成為朋友。今天，你將第一次和她結伴出遊，逛逛自己剛搬來的這座城市。

[來源：[url=http://lunaen.com/games/fairy/]官方網站[/url]]
